title: megastachya ciliata
intro: Megastachya ciliata, commonly known as African boxwood, is a shrub native to tropical Africa. This plant has been found to have several health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Megastachya ciliata include its ability to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues due to its expectorant and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine.
